shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
curved or arcing bands across the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry relief carving that includes an anthropomorphic presence and rounded/disc-like and curved band elements, but this is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A shows finely detailed profile figures in robes beside repeated foliate/leaf motifs organised in horizontal registers along a stepped architectural face, whereas B is a single boldly schematic body-shaped block with a large plain boss, paired lobes and sweeping arcs and no registers, narrative figures or plant motifs — the conventions of depiction are wholly different.
